notes.title: New Steam Trading Cards & Points Shop items!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/926154943760a5a78b41370637f84abddab288ed.jpg[/img]

[h3]Due to popular request, we've added Steam Trading Cards and Points Shop items to [i]New Super Lucky's Tale[/i]![/h3]

There are six trading cards in total, with a drop rate of at least 30 minutes playtime per card. This means there's also a new badge that you can level up as you collect cards!

We also created a bunch of items for the Points Shop, like avatars, backgrounds, emoticons, and even animated stickers. Chances are you have at least a few points accumulated from game purchases, so maybe it's time to pick up a few Lucky charms!

See the Points Store items: https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1038300

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/8ce72b5c288352c14137a9f0b4f7551503b359a7.gif[/img]

notes.title: New demo available for New Super Lucky's Tale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/82276fc279cd3995bf0bf8e530f51c422a08ab84.png[/img]

We have some great news for fans of Lucky who haven't picked up New Super Lucky's Tale yet...

[h2]The game now has a free demo![/h2]

The demo is available today on Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Steam. You can grab it for free and experience the game's opening story and first full level, giving you a taste of the adventure that awaits as you join Lucky on his quest to save the Book of Ages...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/051ab9f15424e68f43b2022ab5cf3aaec053ac88.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/9e182e0a23824696cc180e2ba7015114b4b8b8ed.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/ba2903bbae601716e7ee3f00c027633cd06c4a7e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/d8ac97063bd185f9cdcd488b17419051ba9b153a.jpg[/img]

Critics have been raving about New Super Lucky's Tale, including the recent Steam and console ports. Here's a few of our favorites from the latest reviews...

[list]
[*] "New Super Lucky's Tale is a hidden gem which should be played by everyone."  –GamePitt
[*] "If you're a fan of the genre, you simply have to pick this up and give it a go!"  –ThisGenGaming
[*] "It's an excellent example of a modern platformer."  –PC Invasion
[*] "A simple and fun platformer for anyone looking for an escape from the dark and gritty titles that have dominated the industry this year."  –PlayStation Universe
[*] "Pure platformer pleasure."  –Gamers' Temple
[/list]

If you still don't own the game, give the demo a try! If nothing else, consider Greg the Mail Golem's enthusiastic endorsement...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577147/e1087c1447864afd4f8ea879c751f013810539e3.png[/img]
